errors.evidence: The chart is a stacked bar chart, with one bar per country. The description incorrectly identifies it as having grouped bars.
The description claims the countries on the x-axis are in random order, but they are sorted in ascending order of the total height of the bars (total energy cost).

errors.text_span: Най-високите стълбове се наблюдават при държавите DK и FI
errors.evidence: While DK has the highest bar, the second highest bar corresponds to IE (Ireland), not FI (Finland). Finland's bar is in the lower half of the distribution.

errors.text_span: Някои от стълбовете са визуално подчертани с по-наситен цвят и са очертани.
errors.evidence: The figure does not show any bars being visually highlighted with a more saturated color. All bars and segments are presented uniformly.

errors.text_span: както и дяла на разходите за различните горива в общите им енергийни разходи.
errors.evidence: This phrase is ambiguous. It could refer to the stacked bars (segments as a share of the total bar) or the scatter plot. The scatter plot actually shows the share of energy costs in the households' *total expenditure*, not their *total energy expenditure*. This makes the statement confusing and inaccurate in the context of the scatter plot.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за всяка държава са оцветени различно, за да се разграничат отделните видове енергия.
errors.evidence: This is poorly phrased. It is not the bars themselves that are colored differently, but the segments within each bar that are colored to represent different energy types. A clearer description would be 'The segments of each bar are colored differently...'
